lines.beaver: 선배, 이번 주말에 저희 모임에 와 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Seonbae, would you like to come to our gathering this weekend?
lines.beaver_roman: Seonbae, ibeon jumare jeohui moime wa bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 무슨 모임이야? 소문은 들었는데 잘 몰라.
lines.en: What kind of gathering? I've heard rumors, but I don't really know.
lines.roman: Museun moimiya? Somuneun deureonneunde jal molla.

lines.beaver: 고민을 나누고 서로 조언해 주는 모임이에요.
lines.beaver_en: It's a group where we share worries and give each other advice.
lines.beaver_roman: Gomineul nanugo seoro joeonhae juneun moimieyo.
lines.en: Nice. How many members are there?

lines.beaver_en: Twenty. We get a lot of advice, too.
lines.en: Is it only juniors? I'm older.

lines.beaver_en: Lots of members are around your age too.
lines.en: Really? Is there a membership fee to join?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's ten thousand won a month.
lines.en: The fee is fine. Do new members keep joining?

lines.beaver: 네, 홍보를 안 하는데도 매달 늘어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it grows every month even though we don't advertise.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, hongboreul an haneundedo maedal neureoyo.
lines.en: Interesting. What's said in the group stays secret, right?

lines.beaver: 그럼요. 모임 이야기는 밖에 말하지 않아요.
lines.beaver_en: Of course. We don't talk about it outside.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureomyo. Moim iyagineun bakke malhaji anayo.
lines.learner: 좋아. 상대방 이야기를 잘 듣는 게 중요하겠다.
lines.en: Good. Listening well to the other person must be important.
lines.roman: Joa. Sangdaebang iyagireul jal deunneun ge jungyohagetda.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 친구 관계 고민도 많이 나눠요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. We share a lot of worries about friendships too.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. chingu gwangye gomindo mani nanwoyo.
lines.learner: 나도 친구 관계 때문에 조언이 필요해.
lines.en: I need advice about my friendships too.
lines.roman: Nado chingu gwangye ttaemune joeoni piryohae.

lines.beaver: 그럼 꼭 오세요. 선배한테 도움이 될 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Then please come. It'll really help you.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom kkok oseyo. Seonbaehante doumi doel geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 시험이 있는데도 가 보고 싶어. 가입할게.
lines.en: Even though I have an exam, I want to go. I'll join.
lines.roman: Siheomi inneundedo ga bogo sipeo. Gaiphalge.

lines.beaver: 와, 고마워요! 토요일 세 시에 학교 앞에서 봬요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, thanks! See you Saturday at three in front of school.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, gomawoyo! Toyoil se sie hakgyo apeseo bwaeyo.
lines.learner: 응, 알려 줘서 고마워. 토요일에 보자!
lines.en: Okay, thanks for telling me. See you Saturday!
lines.roman: Eung, allyeo jwoseo gomawo. Toyoire boja!
